translations.zh: 初，吳楚反書聞，兵未發，竇嬰言故吳相爰盎。
translations.literal: At first, when word of the Wu-Chu revolt arrived but troops had not yet been dispatched, Dou Ying spoke of the former chancellor of Wu, Yuan Ang.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when word of the Wu-Chu revolt arrived but troops had not yet marched, Dou Ying mentioned the former chancellor of Wu, Yuan Ang.

translations.zh: 召入見，上問以吳楚之計，盎對曰：「吳楚相遺書，曰『賊臣朝錯擅適諸侯，削奪之地』，以故反，名為西共誅錯，復故地而罷。
translations.literal: Ang was summoned to audience. The emperor asked him about the Wu-Chu situation. Ang replied, "Wu and Chu have sent each other messages saying, 'The wicked minister Chao Cuo has wantonly punished the feudal lords and seized their lands.' For this reason they have rebelled, claiming to execute Chao Cuo together from the west and then restore their former territories and disband.
translations.idiomatic: Ang was summoned to audience. The emperor asked him about the Wu-Chu situation. Ang replied, "Wu and Chu have sent each other messages saying, 'The wicked minister Chao Cuo has wantonly punished the feudal lords and seized their lands.' For this reason they have rebelled, claiming to execute Chao Cuo together from the west and then restore their former territories and disband.

translations.zh: 方今計獨斬錯，發使赦七國，復其故地，則兵可毋血刃而俱罷。」
translations.literal: At present the plan is simply to execute Chao Cuo, send envoys to pardon the Seven States, and restore their former territories—then the armies can both stand down without bloodshed."
translations.idiomatic: At present the plan is simply to execute Chao Cuo, send envoys to pardon the Seven States, and restore their former territories—then the armies can both stand down without bloodshed."

translations.literal: The emperor accepted his counsel and had Chao Cuo executed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his counsel and had Chao Cuo executed.

translations.literal: The full account is given in Ang's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is given in Ang's biography.

translations.zh: 以盎為泰常，奉宗廟，使吳王，吳王弟子德侯為宗正，輔親戚。
translations.literal: Ang was appointed Grand Master of Ceremonies to oversee the ancestral temple. He was sent to the King of Wu, while the king's younger kinsman the Marquis of De was made Director of the Imperial Clan to assist the royal kin.
translations.idiomatic: Ang was appointed Grand Master of Ceremonies to oversee the ancestral temple. He was sent to the King of Wu, while the king's younger kinsman the Marquis of De was made Director of the Imperial Clan to assist the royal kin.

translations.zh: 使至吳，吳楚兵已攻梁壁矣。
translations.literal: When the envoy reached Wu, the Wu-Chu armies had already attacked the walls of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy reached Wu, the Wu-Chu armies had already attacked the walls of Liang.

translations.zh: 宗正以親故，先入見，諭吳王拜受詔。
translations.literal: As Director of the Imperial Clan and a royal kinsman, he entered first to see the king and instruct him to bow and receive the edict.
translations.idiomatic: As Director of the Imperial Clan and a royal kinsman, he entered first to see the king and instruct him to bow and receive the edict.

translations.zh: 吳王聞盎來，亦知其欲說，笑而應曰：「我已為東帝，尚誰拜？」
translations.literal: When the King of Wu heard Ang had come, he knew he meant to persuade him. Laughing, he replied, "I have already become Eastern Emperor—whom else should I bow to?"
translations.idiomatic: When the King of Wu heard Ang had come, he knew he meant to persuade him. Laughing, he replied, "I have already become Eastern Emperor—whom else should I bow to?"

translations.zh: 不肯見盎而留軍中，欲劫使將。
translations.literal: He refused to see Ang and kept him in the army camp, intending to coerce the envoy into becoming his general.
translations.idiomatic: He refused to see Ang and kept him in the army camp, intending to coerce the envoy into becoming his general.

translations.zh: 盎不肯，使人圍守，且殺之。
translations.literal: Ang refused. The king had men surround and guard him, about to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Ang refused. The king had men surround and guard him, about to kill him.

translations.literal: Ang fled by night to Liang and returned to report.
translations.idiomatic: Ang fled by night to Liang and returned to report.
